requirements.anchor: Build a tiny dependency-free Node.js slugifier with automated tests and usage documentation.
requirements.title: Slugifier sample
criteria: `slugify.mjs` exports `slugify(value)`, validates string input with TypeError, applies NFKD/decombining/lowercasing/non-ASCII-alphanumeric separator normalization and edge trimming, including empty/punctuation-only output.
`cli.mjs` imports the API without import side effects, joins arguments with spaces, prints one newline-terminated slug, and reports no-argument usage to stderr with exit code 1.
`slugify.test.mjs` uses Node built-in test/assert and covers roadmap examples, empty and repeated separators, type errors, plus spawned CLI success and no-argument failure.
`README.md` documents API, examples, CLI usage, and `npm test`; project remains dependency-free and changes only the four deliverable files.
`node --test slugify.test.mjs` succeeds, hashes and check evidence are recorded, and independent requirement and whole-roadmap coverage reviews pass against the final manifest.

evidence.description: Node built-in test suite covers required API and CLI cases.

reviews.reasoning: Independent review of the exact manifest: it contains exactly the four requested new deliverables plus supplied package.json and ROADMAP.md. slugify.mjs fulfills string validation, NFKD decomposition, mark removal, lowercase ASCII-only separator collapse, trimming, and empty behavior. cli.mjs imports API and has specified success/no-arg paths. Tests cover all requested API and spawned CLI cases; README covers API, examples, CLI, and npm test. node --test slugify.test.mjs passed 6/6 in operation a3-final-node-test-b.

Inspected final source: slugify.mjs validates string input, uses NFKD plus mark removal, lowercases, collapses non-ASCII-alphanumeric runs and trims hyphens. cli.mjs joins argv, logs exactly one newline-terminated slug, and reports no-argument usage with exit 1. slugify.test.mjs uses node:test/assert and spawnSync for all requested categories. README covers API/examples/CLI/npm test. Controlled node --test slugify.test.mjs passed 6/6.
